title: GL Tie-Out Recompute
description: Independently recomputes subledger-to-GL tie-out totals from a caller-pasted posted ledger and a declared product_code -> gl_account_code chart-of-accounts mapping. Single-source mode sums ledger rows per GL account code for a stated period and diffs the recomputed totals against caller-supplied reported trial-balance figures. Diff mode runs the same summation independently over two full ledger sources (for example a legacy-core export and a new-core export covering the same period during a core conversion) and diffs the two recomputed totals against each other, symmetrically, with no side asserted correct.

mode.description: single: recompute vs a reported trial balance. diff: two full sources diffed against each other for conversion balancing.

ledger.description: Posted transaction rows (single mode). Sec0 shape: account_token, post_date, effective_date, txn_type, amount (integer minor units), running_balance, product_code, description_code.

reported_trial_balance.description: Optional: the core's own reported GL figures per account code (single mode), to tie out against.

source_a.description: First full source for diff mode: { label, ledger, gl_account_mapping }.

source_b.description: Second full source for diff mode: { label, ledger, gl_account_mapping }.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_gl_tieout_recompute
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes subledger-to-GL tie-out totals under a caller-declared chart-of-accounts mapping, either against a reported trial balance (single-source mode) or diffed between two full sources for conversion balancing (diff mode), returning MATCHES, DIVERGES (per-account-code deltas), or INDETERMINATE.

source: authored by CORE-VERIFY-GLTIEOUT-1 per CORE-VERIFY-BUILD-SPEC.md's Sec6, GL tie-out assertion recompute chain. Positioning guardrails: independently recompute and receipt only, never a claim of core-vendor endorsement or that either compared side is correct.
